}}'''Seana''' was a [[Wise One]] of the [[Black Cliffs]] sept of the [[Nakai]] [[Aiel]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Seana|Seana}} She could not [[channel]] but was a [[dreamwalker]].{{ref||Seana}}

== Appearance ==
Seana looked very old, old as [[Bair]], had gray-streaked dark hair and bluish gray eyes.{{ref/book|4|23}} She was usually very calm and often the counter to [[Melaine]]'s temper.

== Activities ==
She, along with [[Amys]], [[Bair]], and [[Melaine]] told [[Rhuarc]] that the dreams say he must go in search of the ''[[Car'a'carn]]'',{{ref/book|3|39}} and sent a letter to [[Moiraine]] ordering [[Aviendha]] to return to the [[Aiel Waste]] and to [[Rhuidean]] to be trained as a Wise One. The letter was addressed to Moiraine at the [[Stone of Tear]], but sent at least a month before she had even arrived there.{{ref/book|4|12}}

She met [[Rand al'Thor]] and the rest of the Aiel on the slopes of [[Chaendaer]] when they were transported from [[Tear]] to [[Rhuidean]] via the [[Portal Stone]].{{ref/book|4|23}} She with the rest of her group of Aiel Wise Ones had sent a letter to [[Moiraine Damodred]] saying where they would meet and which day.

She walked [[Alsera]]'s dreams twice to encourage [[Bruan]] to hurry to [[Alcair Dal]].

She was killed by a [[Draghkar]] when they attacked Rand at [[Cold Rocks Hold]] in the Aiel Waste.{{ref/book|4|50}}
